# iOS Headers - AI Access Guidance

Site: https://headers.82flex.com/
Purpose: Explore iOS SDK header files across versions.

## Search Scope (Important)
The site search only supports:
- Directory names
- Framework names
- Objective-C header file names

The site search does NOT support:
- property names
- ivar names
- method names
- symbol-level full-text code search

## Suggested Usage
- Prefer direct file URLs when available: /view/<version_id>/<absolute_path>
- Use /tree/<directory_name> to navigate directories and list files
	- directory_name format: parent_dir/dir_name (last 2 path segments)
	- examples: CFNetwork.framework/CFNetwork, libexec/backboardd
- Avoid repeated retries for property/ivar/method queries because they are unsupported
